top_signals.title: Ukraine warns of fresh Starshield disruptions as U.S. envoys arrive in Moscow for talks with Putin
top_signals.summary: Starshield is SpaceX's military-grade satellite network designed for government and national security use, building on the technology developed for Starlink.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
